def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    unearned_income = 3400
    tax_free_threshold = 1250
    alex_rate_threshold = 2500
    alex_tax_rate = 0.10
    parent_tax_rate = 0.24

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    alex_taxable_income = alex_rate_threshold - tax_free_threshold
    income_taxed_at_parent_rate = unearned_income - alex_rate_threshold

    tax_at_alex_rate = alex_taxable_income * alex_tax_rate
    tax_at_parent_rate = income_taxed_at_parent_rate * parent_tax_rate
    total_kiddie_tax = tax_at_alex_rate + tax_at_parent_rate

    # return answer
    return round(total_kiddie_tax)
